### 📅 **Timeline of Key Events at the Indira Gandhi Planetarium (Patna)**

| **Date** | **Event** | **Details** |
|--------|---------|-----------|
| **1989** | **Conceptualization** | The planetarium was conceived by Bihar Chief Minister Shri Satyendra Narain Sinha. Construction was initiated in the same year. |
| **1989** | **Construction Begins** | Work on building the planetarium commenced under the Bihar Council on Science & Technology. |
| **1 April 1993** | **Official Opening** | The planetarium was opened to the public, marking the start of its operations. |
| **2016** | **Planning of First Digital Planetarium** | A plan was announced to establish the first digital planetarium in Bihar at the Shrikrishna Science Centre near Gandhi Maidan. (Note: This plan was later realized at the Indira Gandhi Planetarium.) |
| **2021** | **Modernization Works Initiated** | A major revamp project began to upgrade the facility with modern technology. |
| **2023** | **Installation of Digital Projection System** | Six state-of-the-art **Christie projectors** were installed by **ZEISS**, replacing the traditional opto-mechanical celluloid film system. This transition introduced high-resolution 3D digital projections. |
| **2023** | **Facility Upgrades** | The planetarium received a new **hanging dome-shaped screen**, improved **acoustic sound system**, and a modernized interior. |
| **2024 (April)** | **Modernization Completed** | The full modernization project was finalized and officially completed. The facility is now fully equipped with advanced digital technology. |
| **Ongoing** | **Public Engagement & Education** | The planetarium continues to offer regular astronomy film shows, exhibitions, and educational programs. Online ticket booking is available via its official portal. |
